trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up to open it). They cost $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000, and Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each gives you one parking spot, so your registered vehicles are saved for later and can be called with Scooter Bros.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up)
Buy all 8 garages: $160,000 in total
Each garage adds one parking spot for registered vehicles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the service that delivers your fully repaired, registered vehicles to your current location for a small fee. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have an empty parking spot; the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Register 10 different vehicles and the trophy pops. Buy more garages from the Vice City Real Estate app if you run out of parking spots.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Drive a vehicle to a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop
Register it to the Scooter Bros app
Repeat for 10 different vehicles; buy garages for more spots
